correctness.rationale: Correct state-changing rates include each opposing zealot and establish a unique recurrent stationary class. Exact first and pair moment identities and covariance formulas are derived algebraically and independently checked against 16 exact rational stationary chains and 361 moment-equation cases. The stationary-generator argument, mean-square synchronization and compact moment uniqueness prove the beta limit for every proportional-growth sequence; finite tests are not substituted for an infinite proof. Boundaries a,b>=2 and pair-existence conditions are explicit.

value.rationale: Exact finite two-point correlations and a nondegenerate beta stationary limit resolve a natural question about opinion persistence under two opposed fixed influencers on a canonical two-community network. Degree asymmetry tunes the limiting distribution; balanced networks have a uniform stationary vote share. This is an analytically proved classification of motivated natural observables, not a trivial corollary of the well-mixed model.
